text:
alice: FYI -- noticed client errors in staging after the routing header change. python SDK crashed on our integration tests :cry:
ben: Ugh, which header change? the one Carmen rolled out this morning? :eyes:
carmen: yeah, we switched to the compact route header format to reduce payload size. old header was JSON in x-rd-route, new is a compact base64-ish prefix: 
```
# old
x-rd-route: {"policy":"latency","quota":"team-x"}
# new
x-rd-route: v2:eyJw... (compact token)
```
carmen: rollout was staged to canary, but I pushed to more hosts earlier because perf looked good. telemetry sampling showed higher throughput so I increased the canary percentage.
derek: SDKs parse x-rd-route as JSON at runtime, so when they see the v2: prefix they throw and crash. seen in python 0.21.1 and ts 1.4.0 in staging. stack: TypeError from json.loads on a string starting with 'v2:'.
ben: Can we make SDKs tolerant? fallback parsing logic seems easy: try json.loads, if fail and startswith('v2:'), decode compact format.
carmen: we can also temporarily emit the old JSON header in addition to the compact one while SDKs are patched. but doubles header size. tradeoff: stability vs perf.
eve: product concern: console rollout tile showed "policy applied" to 40% of hosts. If we revert canary we lose perf gains but avoid customer impact. Need to quantify affected customers.
alice: reproducer logs: ``
ERROR TypeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
  at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
  at parseRoute (/usr/src/app/lib/routing.js:45:12)
```
ben: suggested quick SDK patch (pseudo):
```
# python
raw = headers.get('x-rd-route')
try:
  meta = json.loads(raw)
except Exception:
  if raw and raw.startswith('v2:'):
    meta = compact_decode(raw[3:])
  else:
    raise
```
derek: I'll open a patch for python and ts, cut a 0.21.2/1.4.1 hotfix. also add unit tests for both formats.
carmen: if you can cut the patches quickly I'll flip the rollout back to previous behavior in 30m to give a safe window. otherwise I'll emit both headers for 24h.
eve: can we add a console alert for SDK error spikes and a per-sdk-version chart? we need to know which customers hit this.
carmen: telemetry team: please flag error rates for header-parsing exceptions and include sdk_version tag. currently we sample at 1% which missed early signs -- can we bump to 10% for the next 2 hours?
deploy-bot: Canary group update: increased to 65% at 2026-03-21T15:12:00Z :shipit:
ben: note: TS SDK uses a tiny binary-decode util for the compact token. ensure code shares logic across languages or publish spec in repo.
derek: PRs: python -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/842, ts -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/1290. both implement dual-parse and add tests.
alice: thanks. i'll run integration tests against the canary hosts after the patches land.
carmen: plan: hold canary at 65%, emit old JSON+v2 for 2h, telemetry bumped to 10%, SDK hotfix published and clients given 48h to upgrade, then revert to v2-only and resume perf rollout.
eve: can we make the console UX clearer for "header format" rollout? add a note in the rollout tile stating "SDKs must accept v2; fallback supported for 48h".
ben: fine. one more ask: add a metric in the console for header-parse-fallback-rate so we can see how many clients relied on fallback.
carmen: will add a dashboard tile.
derek: merging hotfix after tests pass. tagging release with patch notes: "compat: accept compact route header v2 and legacy JSON".
deploy-bot: Canary patch deployed to staging at 2026-03-21T15:38:10Z :rocket:
alice: all tests green on canary integration. no more parse crashes in our suite.
eve: thanks everyone. follow-up: schedule a post-mortem doc in #postmortems if anything customer-facing slipped through. :calendar:
